summary: Settings panel silently resets the SERVER models root when the stored path contains temp/tmp. Guard at MpiSettings.js:348-354 fires on MOUNT and calls _setComfyPath(''), which rewrites extra_model_paths.yaml to the default root - the single source of truth - and /comfy/set-path logs nothing on success. Hit live: G:/CubricModels (144GB) orphaned, no log line, 1.75GB re-downloaded. Substring match means it ships to any user whose models path contains those letters.

Guard deleted (it was redundant - _hydrateComfyPath already reconciles from the YAML), set-path now logs old -> new root on both branches. Suite 282/282, both test halves negative-controlled against HEAD. Sweep clean: every other _setComfyPath call site is user-initiated.
maturity planned -> validating; attention required for the one live restart check.
Needs one app restart to confirm the log line and that opening Settings leaves extra_model_paths.yaml alone.

USER-INDEPENDENT LIVE VERIFICATION - closed. The planned live check (restart the app, open Settings, confirm the root survived) would have been VACUOUS on this machine: the deleted guard only fired when the cached path contained temp/tmp, and the real localStorage holds G:CubricModels, so a clean mount exercises the branch zero times. Poisoned the cache first instead - localStorage mpi_comfy_root_path = D:/AI/temp_models - and drove MpiSettings through the browser at 127.0.0.1:3000, same renderer code, leaving the user Electron storage untouched. Result: extra_model_paths.yaml BYTE-IDENTICAL across the mount (sha256 22ff5a6a3f62e98a, 2006 bytes, before and after) and app.log holds EXACTLY ONE set-path line for the whole session - the deliberate route test - so the mount fired no POST at all, which is stronger than proving the POST was harmless. The field rendered the real root G:CubricModels and localStorage was RECONCILED from the YAML back to it, confirming _hydrateComfyPath already did the guard job. Route half proven by an idempotent same-value POST: [comfy] set-path: models root G:CubricModels -> G:CubricModels at 11:43:52, YAML unchanged; pre-fix that route logged only on error. Negative control on live code with comments stripped (the surviving comment names the old call, so a naive grep reads as unfixed): pre-fix 2f8b865e~1 has the includes(temp)/includes(tmp) branch calling _setComfyPath with an empty string at lines 323-326; HEAD has no match. Acceptance 1-5 live-proven, 6 was the source sweep. The jsdom gap is now closed by real mount evidence instead of a source-text proxy.
